recognize_zh: 高倍下中央一顆紅血球內有邊緣平直、深染的長方形結晶，其餘胞內區域近乎空白（像「金條在盒中」），周圍多為標靶細胞與摺疊細胞，符合血紅素C結晶。
features: Single red cell containing a dense, dark rectangular crystal with straight parallel edges and a clear residual cell outline
Many target cells with central hemoglobin condensation
Folded and irregularly contracted red cells
Occasional small spherocytic cells and a teardrop-like fragment
describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells and folded cells. A central red cell contains a sharply marginated, dark-staining rectangular crystal, with the rest of the cell appearing pale and empty. No sickle cells or irregular SC-type crystals are seen. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin C crystals of homozygous hemoglobin C disease.

ddx.vs: SC crystals are irregular with blunt, finger-like projections rather than a regular rectangular or hexagonal outline.
These are small round dots, not a large geometric crystal filling much of the cell.
Overlap produces a denser zone with curved borders and no empty residual cell membrane.
